name: Lucky Tower 2
summary:
Lucky Tower 2 is an action-adventure game that serves as a sequel to the 2010 flash game "Lucky Tower". You take control of a young knight who sets off on a quest to escort a man named "Anton Kaufmann" back to the castle. Things only go down south from there.

The game features new mechanics such as a health bar represented as teeth, killing enemies to gather loot, and combining objects to solve puzzles. Just like the first game, you will be seeing yourself dying in many unexpected and funny ways.
